objective: Add indexed thumbnails and proxy policy
flags: Edit proxies on by default in the editor (per-browser choice); export and reference preview unchanged (originals only)
deviations: Proxies are a rebuildable per-project cache keyed by content hash, profile and FFmpeg build (the YU-016 peaks pattern), not registered derivative versions: a proxy never joins the project, so the immutable original and its lineage are untouched and deleting the cache loses nothing

core/jobs.ts, core/store.ts and src/editor/components/PreviewPlayer.tsx were not changed: the preview switches files through the first-party adapter (src/adapter.ts) and main.tsx, so the donor-derived player keeps its provenance record
Sources whose first video frame is not at time zero are refused (measured: FFmpeg normalises such a proxy's start, 0.5 s -> 0.033 s), so they play their originals

tests.result: proxy-timing 12/12: a moving-bar fixture shows the same frame in source and proxy at trim points and in-between times at 30 fps and 60 fps (the measure distinguishes neighbouring frames); per-frame presentation times and audio start matched before publishing; publish leaves project objects unchanged; restart quarantine then completion; running and queued cancel (queued returns under 2 s); per-project builds; missing, relinked (other bytes), damaged proxy, variable-rate, late-start and damaged-source refusals; rotated phone video upright; thumbnails bounded, cached, video only; command scopes and strict inputs; the toggle changes only the played file (clips, trims, durations equal). http: the media key opens /proxy and /thumbnail and nothing beyond. Edge E2E: the preview switches to the proxy once ready and back to the original when toggled off, 0 page errors, 0 external requests
tests.measurements: On this host, under the sandboxed worker: a 4 s 1280x720 30 fps source builds, verifies and publishes in about 3-6 s (test wall times 3.4-6.2 s, including fixture encode); a 2 s 960x540 60 fps source in about 3.6-5.2 s. Proxy height 540 (960x540 from 720p; 304x540 from portrait 360x640). Per-proxy disk bound min(max(64 MiB, 2x source), 1 GiB, half the space above the reserve); per-project cache 2 GiB. No playback frame-rate claim: that is YU-018's qualification

limitations: No proxy disk budget across projects (per proxy and per project only)
A proxy evicted during a session plays only after a page reload; the player does not fall back on a media error
While the toggle is on, the editor asks again for a proxy that a client cancelled through the API
A probe timeout inside the general media probe is still remembered as a settled failure for 10 minutes
Videos that do not start at time zero get no proxy
No editor component draws thumbnails yet (the route and cache exist)
Playback budgets (S/M, under export pressure) are measured by YU-018
